baselinePrompt:
Night exterior of a covered parking area or carport bay at a commercial property. The setting is a flat concrete pad under a low overhead canopy with a brick pillar visible on the right edge. Beyond the canopy opening stretches a dark parking lot with a row of trimmed bushes and illuminated trees in the far background, distant warm streetlights glowing softly against a pitch-black sky.

Parked facing right-to-left, dominating the right two-thirds of the frame, sits a Lamborghini Aventador in vivid orange-red with gloss black wheels, black side air intakes, and a low aggressive stance. Its scissor door on the driver's side is raised fully vertical at the start of the clip, the inner door panel black with a small red indicator light visible on its lower section.

The clip opens with [INFLUENCER] entering frame from the left, back turned fully to camera, wearing a plain navy blue short-sleeve crew-neck t-shirt, loose dark olive/charcoal cargo-style denim jeans, and tan/wheat-coloured ankle boots. He wears a metal-bracelet watch on his left wrist. He walks at a normal, casual pace toward the rear of the Lamborghini, his right hand trailing along and briefly touching the rear quarter panel and rear wheel arch area as he moves up alongside the car.

The camera holds a fixed position low and slightly behind, shooting from a three-quarter rear-left angle on [INFLUENCER] so his back fills the left portion of frame while the car's rear and side fill the right. The car's rear tail and licence plate area are visible at the start; as [INFLUENCER] walks forward toward the open door the camera slowly drifts in, tightening the frame so the driver's door opening and [INFLUENCER]'s back-and-side profile fill more of the shot.

[INFLUENCER] arrives at the open scissor door, pauses briefly facing into the cockpit, then begins lowering himself into the extremely low seat. He grips the top of the raised door panel with his right hand, ducks his head forward and down to clear the roofline, swings one leg then the other over the sill, and gradually folds his body into the cabin. His legs — jeans and tan boots — are last to disappear as he slides his feet in and settles into the seat. His watch-bearing wrist and forearm rest on the window opening momentarily.

As his body clears the door frame the scissor door begins to descend on its own, lowering smoothly until it closes flush with the body. The camera by this point has drifted slightly lower and further around to a true side profile of the car, showing the full orange flank, closed scissor door, black wheel, and the dark background behind. [INFLUENCER]'s forearm with the watch remains briefly visible resting casually on the open window ledge as the clip ends on a clean side-profile shot of the car sitting alone on the concrete under the night sky.

Lighting throughout is practical night: warm sodium-glow spill from distant parking lot lights catches the car's glossy orange paint, the concrete reflects faint ambient light, and the upper half of the frame is dominated by deep black night sky. No artificial fill — the scene has a natural, unlit, candid quality consistent with a handheld smartphone shoot.
